issuer.description: Who issued the transcript, from the page header

issuing_authority.description: The school district or education department named at the top of the page, e.g. 'New York City Department Of Education'

school_name.description: The high school the transcript is for, printed under the title

transcript_type.description: Whether the transcript says it is official or an unofficial student copy, as stated on the page; null if not stated

printed_at.description: The date and time the transcript was printed, from the page footer, as printed

student.description: The student record block at the top left of the transcript

name.description: The student's name, the part of 'Name / ID' before the slash, as printed (LAST, FIRST)

student_id.description: The student ID number, the part of 'Name / ID' after the slash

address.description: The student's full mailing address from 'Address:', on one line

date_of_birth.description: The date of birth from 'DOB:', as printed

grade_level.description: The current grade level from 'Grade Level:', as a number

admit_date.description: The date the student was admitted to the school, from 'Admit Date:', as printed

discharge_date.description: The discharge date from 'Discharge Date:'; null if blank

graduation_date.description: The graduation date from 'Graduation Date:'; null if blank

counselor.description: The guidance counselor's name from 'Counselor:', as printed

terms.description: Every term section on the transcript, one entry per 'YYYY / Term: N' heading, in the order printed

year.description: The year in the term heading, e.g. 2022 from '2022 / Term: 2'

term.description: The term number in the term heading, e.g. 2 from '2022 / Term: 2'

courses.description: Each course row listed under this term heading

school_code.description: The school code in the first column, e.g. '31R455'

course_code.description: The course code in the second column, e.g. 'EES88', without any trailing asterisks

course_title.description: The course title as printed, including any truncation

weighted.description: True if the course code is followed by '**', which the footer defines as a weighted course

actual_mark.description: The mark in the 'Actual Mark' column, as printed, keeping any letter or trailing asterisk, e.g. '95', '99*' or 'P*'

numeric_equivalent.description: The value in the 'Numeric Eq' column; null if blank

not_averaged.description: True if the actual mark carries a single '*', which the footer defines as not averaged

credits_attempted.description: The first number of the course's credits pair 'attempted / earned', e.g. 1.00 from '1.00 / 1.00'

credits_earned.description: The second number of the course's credits pair 'attempted / earned'

term_credits_attempted.description: The term total credits attempted, the first number after 'Term: Credits Attempted / Credits Earned:'

term_credits_earned.description: The term total credits earned, the second number after 'Term: Credits Attempted / Credits Earned:'

term_average.description: The term average percentage from 'Term Avg:', as a number without the percent sign, e.g. 80.92
